column1: # Expected rule of every competition for games to 2300 (future testing, 30 October 2026). Input of
# tests/seasons/future/history_check.py and checked by ctest future_competitions.
# The after-table rule: after its last table edition a competition continues on its last cycle, with
# the host from the original game's host rule. Expected years after the table: next_year + k * cycle, to end_year
# or 2300. Years are history years: an autumn-spring competition holds the end year of its season (2028 for
# 2027/28), a calendar-year competition its year, a super cup the year of the match (read from the 2025 gate save
# by the history checker, 30 October 2026). Rows of nation rules and the substitute rule have no history row.
# status: "code as decided" or "fault" for the competition's own year rule. Faults of the season machinery that hit
# many rows are named in the note:
#   F2099 (fixed in 0.6.2 slice 1): up to 0.6.1 season_change.c:773 ran no season hook for a season above 2099.
#   F2101 (fixed in 0.6.2 slice 9a): up to 0.6.1 season_club_cups.c ended the next-edition search at 2101.
#   F2037 (fixed in 0.6.2 slice 10): up to 0.6.1 the 10-season lookback (season_playoffs.c, season_divisions.c,
#          season_sizes.c) found no row after 2037, so league sizes, promotion and play-off rules stopped.
#   F2057 (fixed in 0.6.2 slice 10): up to 0.6.1 the 30-season lookback of season_bra_states.c found no row after 2057.
#   FCUP2099 (fixed in 0.6.2 slice 1): up to 0.6.1 the cups, cup groups, new cups, four-club super cups and the
#          substitute rule took the start year's rule for a competition year above 2099.
